description: Live testing of obsidian-memory PI extension via pi CLI with OpenRouter backend

tests.name: Run obsidian_memory health check
tests.evidence: Health check completed. Vault has 4,399 issues: 4,298 orphan files, 4,277 dead-end files, 101 unresolved links. Status: fragmented but functional.
tests.notes: Vault contains imported source code and build artifacts mixed with knowledge content. Recommendation: clean up and establish wiki structure.

tests.name: Search for 'pi agent test' and return top 3 hit titles
tests.command: pi -e .../obsidian-memory.ts -p "Search for 'pi agent test' and return top 3 hit titles"
tests.evidence: Found 3 results: (1) commander-task-system/_index.md, (2) cmd CLI Architecture & Task Creation Flow.md, (3) Config, Tests & Build Health Analysis.md
tests.notes: Search functionality working correctly; returns relevant results with proper titles.

tests.name: Ingest a new note with title, content, and tags
tests.command: pi -e .../obsidian-memory.ts -p "Ingest a new note with title, content, and tags"
tests.evidence: File written to: raw/PI Agent Comprehensive Test Probe 001.md
tests.notes: Ingest creates file with correct metadata and frontmatter.

tests.name: Get incoming backlink count for wiki/_master-index.md
tests.command: pi -e .../obsidian-memory.ts -p "Get incoming backlink count for wiki/_master-index.md"
tests.notes: Backlinks function returns count correctly; master index has no incoming links.

tests.name: Get outbound link count for wiki/_master-index.md
tests.command: pi -e .../obsidian-memory.ts -p "Get outbound link count for wiki/_master-index.md"
tests.evidence: Count: 4 outbound links found (Active Goals, Ricardo Personal Wiki, Technical Stack, wiki/Ricardo/_index.md)
tests.notes: Outbound links function works; correctly identifies 4 links including unresolved ones.

tests.name: Search for newly ingested 'PI Agent Comprehensive Test Probe' note
tests.command: pi -e .../obsidian-memory.ts -p "Search for newly ingested 'PI Agent Comprehensive Test Probe' note"
tests.evidence: Found: 'PI Agent Comprehensive Test Probe 001' at raw/PI Agent Comprehensive Test Probe 001.md
tests.notes: Newly ingested note is immediately searchable; demonstrates index updates correctly.

tests.name: Write a new wiki entry under wiki='pi-tests'
tests.command: pi -e .../obsidian-memory.ts -p "Write a new wiki entry under wiki='pi-tests'"
tests.notes: Wiki write creates file in correct subdirectory structure with proper metadata.

notes: All tests passed successfully. The obsidian-memory extension is fully functional for ingest, search, backlinks, links, and wiki write operations. The vault has known fragmentation issues (many orphaned files due to mixed source code) but the extension handles them gracefully.
cleanup_notes: Created 2 new files during testing (marked in created_files array). These can be cleaned up manually if desired, but vault keeps history.
scope: Live testing of obsidian-memory PI extension via pi CLI with OpenRouter backend
